violations.why: irq_fjord can preempt the task between the two reads of v_kestrel in fn_indigo and fn_saffron, so the two reads can see different values.
irq_beacon, through irq_orchid, can write v_iris between the read in fn_indigo and the read in fn_saffron.
irq_beacon can write v_iris between the two reads of v_iris in the area expression, so the two reads can differ.
